text: Don't be fooled by the quiet corner of a strip mall that is very easy to never pull into.  Best food around.  Hole in the wall, well kept Nashville secret.  Churasco sandwich is incredible.  Hot chicken tacos, butternut squash, all great.  You know what, never mind.  Don't go there.  You probably won't like it.  Go to CiCis pizza next door.  It's more your speed.

Visited St. Louis for work and asked my customer and local colleague where to go for dinner. They both said Sugarfire. I absolutely love BBQ. I had high hopes since MO is known for having good BBQ. Sadly, it did not live up to my expectations. I wish my colleagues were willing to drive to the better one downtown for dinner. 

Here's what happens when you go in. You stand in a long line since it's cafeteria style. The menu is on the wall. While we were waiting, the one very nice man turned on the no brisket sign. We were all so sad. The. He turned it around by saying the slices of brisket were gone but the chunks of brisket were still possible in the cheesesteak so most of us got that. 

I also got bacon on my cheesesteak and a side of beans. The cheesesteak was just ok and somehow they didn't get the bacon right which makes no sense. Who ruins bacon? The beans had no taste so I only ate a little bit. My colleague had the brisket stroganoff and he said it was very good. Wish I had gotten that too. 

It's unfortunate the food was just mediocre because the people who work there are very nice and helpful.

Only the best diner in the world. First of all the place is a retro standout. Often a line to get in at popular times but plenty of seating slightly off peak hours. Eating outside is a bonus. Seats vary so aim for the comfortable ones. Best servers anywhere. Sure, some are quirky but all are attractive and accommodating. As for the food: great! The breakfast sandwich is a standout. It's a soft boiled egg on a croissant with bacon and lots more. The fries area a heart attack waiting to happen, but worth losing a few years of life for this side. The shrimp and grits is/are spectacular. The soups are delicious. Can't say enough about this fantastic experience.

I've never had actual Szeschwan (americaized Chinese with a Szeschwan lable sure) ...so, I don't know how this rates on a "real" Szeschwan scale.  I can, however, tell you this food was amazing.  I had a chicken hot pot - pure guess - delecate chicken, space veggies, in a hot pepper oil... Brought to the table in a pot on top of an open flame.  

I honestly can't wait to be back in the area so I can eat dinner here again!

Love love love brunch at LouVino! I frequent the Mass Ave location and the vibe is always great. It's one of my favorite places for mimosas and wine flights. They're open during brunch and dinner but not in between. I definitely recommend making a reservation, it gets pretty packed on the weekends.

I left an open mic at a local coffee shop late one Saturday and stumbled upon the bar here while driving home hungry. Great atmosphere and to be honest the bar area on the ground level with a few booths makes it feel "festivaly cozy". I ended up ordering a house cider and buffalo chicken dip. I will be honest I'm not a fan of buffalo chicken dip but they told me it wouldn't disappoint and boy it didn't! The chicken wasn't shredded to death like pulled pork would be.. instead it was roasted chicken that they hand pulled so some chunks were longer or thicker than others it the amount of gory cheese was awesome it was sooo stringy coming out of the bowl of dip! I had to get a refill on chips though because I wanted to get every last bite I could from the pretty epic bowl of buffalo chicken dip! I would not hesitate to go back at all! I mean I do not like buffalo chicken dip at all.. but this was amazing! I mean think about this if they can make a dish I don't like and make me crave more and more think about their tacos or other foods I love! And just how awesome they are! Will be back again you can bet your lucky stars on that!

Unbelievably rude reception. Asked how many in our party.  Told them five with one being a two year old that needs a booster seat.  From that moment on we were ignored as other parties were seated.   Rudeness seems to be the way of doing business at this place.  Don't talk to the customer and maybe they will go away!!

Finally a server who wanted us in his station.  Thank you Ron for taking great care of us and making two little girls very happy.

This is a bit delayed but 5* non the less..
On Jan 30th, I called from Tucson, Az and couldn't use a charge over the phone. (Wanted to surprise party with dessert).. BUT they were too cool ..the Mgr actually brought my sis in law, a loyal customer and Metairie resident, a FREE birthday dessert.. she was shocked and it made her day thanks for your generosity and great customer service.. we, of course, will be back

From out of town and had pulled in for a to go order. I ordered a Greek salad.. got to the hotel to unpack a salad that is made with yellowed, wilted lettuce. I ordered it with no onions, it came with onions and zero dressing. None. And none on the side. I had to throw it away. When in Boise I'll definitely eat somewhere else.

I have been to New Orleans a million times and dined everywhere but this is by far the best. Everything I ordered was delicious. Don't leave without ordering the gumbo and grilled oysters you won't be disappointed.Thank you Timia for  your great hospitality and food recommendations.

I really shouldn't skip meals. Because there HAS to be a camera SOMEwhere that captured me diving in and out of the box handed through my car's driver-side window like it was a bucket of KFC (the good KFC from back in the day). 

I'm so serious. My "BUD Box" (two special tacos, chips, and queso) was so good that I didn't even THINK about what I could save for another chow down fest. I ate it all!

And the whole order online/pick-up thing due to Corona V was so easy. 

Please, friends! We need this restaurant. I need this restaurant! Do ME a favor and try the  really good grub from Condado Tacos - Indianapolis - Broad Ripple at home. You'll be glad you did. 

#Getlostindiana

A friend and I ordered 1lb of head on shrimp and 1lb of crawfish with the fever signature mix (medium). The shrimp were mushy and didn't taste fresh, (there were more shrimp heads in the bag than actual shrimp). The crawfish were actually okay in terms of freshness but the seasoning was terrible. The sauce was very gritty, didn't taste like much of anything and didn't have any spice to it at all. Even when heated up, the sauce didn't melt one bit. It was way too thick. Maybe we had a bad batch. Not sure but we definitely won't be eating here again.

Giving it two stars because we didn't have to wait long to be seated, but everything else was horrible. Our waitress wasn't as attentive as she could've been. Maybe it was a lot on her I'm not sure. Our food took forever to come when we got it it was warm. The overall taste was very basic. They ran out of blue crabs and substituted it with what they wanted to substitute it with. The appetizers we ordered never came, neither did the drinks. Some of our tickets were wrong as well we stayed the for about 3 1/2 hours. I can honestly say I won't be going back ever again.

Wow! This was the place I chose to go for my first outing since quarantine. Because it was restaurant week, my boyfriend and I wanted to go somewhere that was special (and safe). We wanted to sit by the water and the hostess was really nice to accommodate us.

This experience was wonderful! Our server always had a mask on and was always willing to help us in any way. First thing I ordered was a mangojito, which was phenomenal. The right amount of sweetness to start the meal. The appetizers, however, was the star of the show. I ordered a spicy tuna on crispy rice and it was awesome. The flavors were perfectly combined with the spicy and the tangy. My boyfriend ordered the lobster bisque, and it was probably the best I've ever had. It was creamy and it was full of flavor that was fresh.

I also tried the Atlantic salmon for the main course. I really enjoyed the mustard aioli that came with it. The rainbow surf and turf was good as well. It was comforting and home-y. For dessert, we had a trio of carrot cake, no flour brownie, and cheesecake. It was served with a raspberry drizzle on the plate. The carrot cake was soft and moist. The brownie had a toffee icing, which was delicious. But the cheesecake let me tell you. That was so good. It was creamy and it would just melt in your mouth. Plus there was a very thin layer of white chocolate on the bottom that just added bonus points.

I definitely recommend this place and I hope to try it out again for their regular menu!
The pizza was just ok and both the cheese cakes, strawberry and Oreo, were both awful. We do like our cheese cakes but have never tasted any that bad. We won't be ordering from here anymore.

Lunch buffet is over priced at $13. Somehow they never seem to get around to bringing out the so called complimentary dosa either. Table service is non existent at lunch. Although I like the food it's not extraordinary and I'm kind of over this place.

This place was awesome! We waited in line for 15 min and the line was huge. They really know how to crank out a crowd. We ordered the raw and char grilled oysters and would definitely recommend! The fish and shrimp I ordered was ok, which is why I didn't want to give the full five. Overall, this place is somewhere I'd make sure to come back to. The oysters were phenomenal!

Came at 7:15 P.M. Left at 8:15. Group of 8.
Super fun and great for family event or a date. Nice mix of things to do and food. Love the local entertainment
Liked their pizza which I would order again, but was disappointed in the hoagie I ordered. Would be great if they sliced their lunch meats thinner.

Not as good as others raving about it. 

The pho and frankly everything else is sub par. I think people appreciate it being a more american style restaurant to feel like it's cleaner than a small Vienamese store like Saigon Deli but honestly the small stores are what the real gem is at. Good thing about Thinh An though is that it opens for dinner too and it has a food section where you can get some ready to eat/to-go Vienamese food.

The food here is surprisingly good!  I absolutely love the Glory Days Grill Bowl with chicken.  Their grilled chicken is soooo flavorful and cooked perfectly.  I also love their dry rubbed wings.  They never disappoint.  It does get really busy for games so if you're covid conscious I'd recommend avoiding those times.  Another pro tip is to check out their weekly specials and join the glory days club. You'll get a free buffalo dip!

In the middle of Indiana, I didn't expect to find the best pupusas ever but I did and it's here.

We ordered to go and everything was made to order, so we didn't mind waiting about 10-15 minutes. We got the revuelta, camaron, queso, and chorizo pupusas as well as choco flan, choriqueso dip, and two tacos.

The tacos were giant and had a lot of meat, but they weren't the best I've ever had. But the stars of the show were the pupusas and dip. The salsas and slaw pair perfectly with the pupusas. Some of the salsas were pretty spicy and it was amazing. Each pupusa was hot and full of flavor and filling. The camaron was unlike anything I've had - for sure the best one. They definitely did not skimp on the shrimp. The dip was so good too, full of cheese and beans and chorizo. You can tell they make their own chips fresh! It was good but one star docked bc they were really really salty. Other than that, everything was perfect. Can't wait to come back when I'm back in Indy!

Another Yelp Discovery!  This place is a gem.  Our Sunday brunch here was FANTASTIC!  The food was delicious.  The service was outstanding-attentive and efficient without being intrusive.  

I had The Belgian (of course), an authentic Belgian waffle topped with Nutella, bananas, strawberries and whipped cream.  Mmmmm mmmm mmmmm GOOD!
I also had an Omlette waffle with chicken breast and Swiss cheese.  I rarely order cheese in my waffle but the server recommended it and I'm glad I listened.  It was excellent, too.

My wife tried the tradition Belgian waffle called the Liege and she liked it, too.

All in all, this place is a WINNER! And,

Like the Terminator, I'll be back.
Old School is my go to when looking for an amazing sandwich. I've brought many people here and they are always pleased with the experience. The smothered buzzard is out of this world.
Great service....under new ownership and the changes are great. Food is amazing. There now open for brunch with $12 bottomless mimosas.

Was in the mood for a turkey burger, in which the company burger was recommended. I was surprise too see a burger joint so crowded especially on a Wednesday. I ordered a turkey burger along with a side of fries. There is only one option of cheese, American. Was a lil disappointed because American cheese is so basic . Everything here is made fresh and you're able to watch the staff prepare your meal. After placing your order you are provided with a stand and ticket number ;  an attendant will bring you your meal once it's completed. However in my opinion it would be easier to just announce order over speaker. Due to the establishment being crowded, I decided to take my food to go. The burger was very fulfilling which was quit shocking. Didn't need to order Fries , was to full off burger to eat fries. The couple fries I did eat were a little too salty ; next time I will just request no salt on fries.

Naya is a delicious healthy take out spot for lunch. I have been to the NY locations many times, and it was great to that there is a location in Chicago. 
The ordering process is similar to ordering at Chipotle, but with a healthier twist. First you pick your base- rice, or salad, or a roll. Then you pick your meat- they have meat like chicken shawarma, lamb kebab and falafel. Then you get to pick your toppings- there are unlimited toppings which is my favorite thing. I love picking feta cheese and hummus. 
The portion sizes are good, you will be full but since its not too heavy, you won't fall asleep after this meal.

I went here to celebrate Easter with my family and I was content with the quality of food at this buffet. I'm not a huge fan of Chinese food but I really enjoyed the amount of options present and how often the dishes were replaced! It was a good mix of Western and Asian cuisine! I'm not a huge fan of buffets either because I am not a huge eater but I would definitely come back here again!

I really enjoyed their ice cream selection (just wish it was labeled!), their sushi, and salt pepper calamari.

Bank and Bourbon is a must when visiting Philly. Their employees are very welcoming and huge shout out to their bartenders for mixing up amazing bourbon cocktails. My go-to drink is a Sazerac. I recently visited a speakeasy in Rome and to my surprise the cocktails at here at Bank and Bourbon were not only on par with the speakeasy, but far surpassed it. It's only a couple blocks from city hall and right across from the Reading Terminal. Thank you to bartender Tyler and Food & Beverage manager Frederick for making our stay special.

Great service, excellent beef pho, dumplings, fried rice, and portions. 

Pan-seared rice noodles were under the veggies, sauce and  seafood, which rendered them soggy. 

Otherwise, fabulous!

Much leftovers, so great value. Will be back.

A chilly day, Hugh ceilings: bring a sweater!
Meh...Expected a lot more.  The seafood diablo was not nearly as spicy as advertised and rather bland.  Merely ok.

Food was much better than expected artichoke dip was fantastic and the service was superb. Meals were outstanding and surroundings were very comfortable! 
I would recommend the living room !

Stopped in on the way to Navarre, FL. Everything we ordered was on the money. Great food and found my personal favorite beer from Bearded Iris. My family and I had a great time. Music/entertainment was great, the food and atmosphere was equal. I highly recommend stopping by!

Ordered take out. 2 broiled crab cakes, 6 fried butterfly shrimp. Comes with tartar sauce and cocktail sauce. $26. No bread given with meal.  Crab cakes were very good, just on the small side.  Shrimp were ok, needed more seasoning.  Will return.

If you want fun, simple, new aged and great tasting ice cream this is the place. It's not an overwhelming menu. You get 4 choices of KRĒM, chocolate or vanilla cake and a choice of a sauce. This was our 2nd time back and I'm excited for the next!! You absolutely get what you pay for!

Some of the best sushi around. Pair with the Sake tasting for the full experience. It is an experience. Everyone is seated at one time and served accordingly. On street parking is tough but there is a public lot around the corner/across the street. Enjoy !
I love this place. The Pho is very good and the service is fast. Spring rolls were so so, but the Pho broth was great!
Nice little cozy spot for some great tasting food.  Guac and chips order could include more guac to share with but other than that great price and good food

I called in my order for pickup.I gave my credit card number four times and she still couldn't get it.So I said I would pay cash.
I called when I arrived but they couldn't bring to my car.I went in and paid for it with my credit card and asked for my order. They hadn't even made it and was told get in line.
They were totally unorganized and I waited until all the walk-in patrons were taken care of.
Not a happy camp
One of my favorite dive bars! Great food, cheap drinks, great location, and a friendly staff!

Came on a date here with my boyfriend from fort sask, and it was awesome, we went on a Sunday night and it was quiet and a super nice atmosphere, drinks came quick and an overall good experience, we will be back for sure!

Stumbled across Rudy's while exploring the area. We got the Chile relleno burrito and a taco/enchilada combo. The burrito was pretty fantastic. The crispy beef taco was one of the best I've had. Cheese enchilada was ok. Fantastic beans and rice. Service was very friendly. They were busy and several of the orders before us got mixed up. But again, great service and food. I'd definitely go back.

The food was awesome. There was a language barrier when ordering but the waitress brought someone over that spoke better English. A little confusing how to order but we soon got the hang of it. Everything was fresh and the broth was flavorful. Next time we will have a better idea how to do it and how much food to order. We easily had enough for 4 people. Very good value for price.

I will DEFINITELY come back to this place!! I arrived at the establishment and was given a professional and safe greeting by the hostess. As a party of one (1) I was given a 20min wait time- No Big Deal! I waited 5mins before receiving the text that my table was ready. Customers were seated in a socially distanced manner. 

Within 3mins of being seated, my server came to the table and took my drink and appetizer order. Within 7 mins both were on my table. The drink was absolutely amazing!!! The chargrilled oysters were piping HOT!!! The oysters were fresh and full of flavor (and just enough garlic butter)!! 

The Seafood Combination Platter was really good... the fries were not as hot as I preferred but overall tasty!!! The shrimp were to die for!!!! There's nothing like fresh Gulf Shrimp!!! The fried fish was piping hot and full of flavor and not overly breaded! 

I was pretty full, but I ordered Dessert to have a complete dining experience (Call it Greedy I guess). Nonetheless, I ordered their Homemade Bread Pudding with a scoop of ice cream. It was the perfect ending to a good experience!!! Flavorful and buttery and definitely delicious!!! Of course, it was piping hot and I have no complaints about that! 

I was Full and Eager to return after this experience. The servers and staff were excellent. They wore masks and, upon observation, pitched in to help everyone- which contributed to fast friendly service!!

Excellent choice for a delicious and tasty meal! I had the sizzling noodle bowl and loved every bit of it...fantastic flavor. Next time I'm definitely getting the stir fry bowl with beef! There are so many options on the menu and you can't go wrong with any of 'em!

Muy Buena Churrasqueria y Muy Buena Atencion de Todo el Personal , especialmente su Manager , que nos dio a degustar varios cortes de carne . El salad bar estaba muy variado y fresco , donde inclusive pudimos encontrar Un Salmón Muy Rico. Las Salchichas que sirven son Muy Muy Buenas ... De veras lo recomiendo !!!

Amazing food. Amazing service. Great location. The server we had last night had a full sleeve tattoo and glasses but I forgot her name. She was so so nice and attentive and asked us how our food was many times and checked up on us. She went above and beyond to make
sure we were happy with our food. One of the best servers in St. Pete I think. 
The seafood ink squid pasta was delicious!!! It was the right amount of spicy and had a lot of seafood in it. This is one of my favorite Italian places here!!

I ordered $76 worth of food and was told it would be 18-21 minutes.  More than twice that time 45 minutes my food comes out.  I asked for more salt because the fries didn't come with enough even though my order said extra salt.  The employee said I would have to pay extra. - for salt!  After a late and wrong order worth $76.  Save your money and go elsewhere
Best takeout in Tampa! Their fried rice and sweet and sour chicken is my go to when I am craving Chinese. They are always super friendly too!

Ryan was fabulous last night! Our initial reservation was messed up and he was still able to sit our party of 6. Food was phenomenal, I'd go back for the Whipped Ricotta & Fig Toast alone! Desserts were also to die for. Can't wait to come back!

Stanley is a great brunch spot!  The food is terrific and the staff is very attentive.  There are obviously a lot of restaurants in New Orleans, and many within the French Quarter, but Stanley's is the only place I have become a regular!   

If you're a local, or just visiting the city, add Stanley's to your list of "To do's" and you won't regret it!
Top notch, and very generous sizes :) milkshakes perfectly mixed, and serves are fast and accurate.

We were able to eat outside despite the downpour as they had the bar area enclosed but still in the fresh air and under heaters. The service was very professional and the drink selection did not disappoint. My breaded snapper was delicious and my wife's crab legs were obviously fresh. I didn't know creamed corn was missing anything but now I do, it's jalapeno. My only complaint was I felt they could be more contentious of the global pandemic and distance guests farther away from each other.

I enjoyed the chicken and waffle. The chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The waffle was sweet and flavorful. The biscuits and jams were tasty too. The service, however, was lacking. We waited quite a while to get our food and to receive our check at the end of the meal. They offer cashless payments and paperless menus. If I'm in the area, I'd try them again.
This is one of my favorite places to order from especially late night! Foods amazing as well!!

Im not sure why I haven't written a review for this place because I come here at least once a week/every other week. This is located in a plaza with other restaurants and supermarket nearby. There is parking but it may get busy especially on the weekends - it's packed and can be hard to find parking. 

What I really love about this place is how fast the service is. If you know what you want, the server will get your order in and within 5-10 mins, your food will be served. They serve complimentary hot tea if you'd like. And sometimes I would ask for green onions/hot oil on the side for that extra richness for the broth.  

Hands down, my favorite and my go-to pho spot. It is cash only, which is the only downside but they do have a Atm inside.

I don't frequent Sabrinas often anymore because I cook my own brunch and don't like waiting for a table but if I have friends or family in town, then this is definitely I place I bring them for breakfast or lunch. Just put your name on the list before heading over or be prepared to wait. Also, portions are enormous so don't be afraid to order half portions.

Yikes. Decided to charge almost 50$ and send one lone ass box of bottom ass broke rip tips. Missing an entire dinner and 4 sides, and 1 drink. 
All I wanted for my birthday was some 
Someone's business is struggling, 
Better customer service, means more regular clientele. 
The workers are too incompetent to even answer the phone properly

There is a very good reason why Lemon Tree has 5 stars. I could find zero faults or room for improvement. 

Awesome location on the corner of 10th and Bannock. Cute and slightly vintage vibe. Has tons of windows, outside seating and a cute loft. You order up front and then they bring you food and drink. 

The staff was so swift and friendly. Our drinks were brought to our table as we were sitting down. The food came about 7 minutes later and they were super busy when we were there. 

We had the hardest time deciding because every option looked better than the last. We both got a combo (great deal!) 1/2 deluxe sandwich, full side of choice and lemonade. You can be more fancy and upgrade to beer, wine or one of their amazing lemosas (lemonade + bubbles). 

My buddy got the Pastrami Reuben with tomato basil bisque and I got the Sausage & Pear with the beet salad. Neither could be improved upon. The Reuben had the best pastrami...which I don't even like. The slaw on it was amazing. Slightly spicy but with a perfect pickle. My Sausage and Pear was awesome. Loved the unique combo. Both our sides were simple but packed with flavor. We also got Strawberry Basil Lemonade. I'm not a sweet drinker so I only drank half but not because it wasn't delicious. Can't wait to try everything on the menu!

Very pleased with the Hawaiian food.  And so happy they have Hum Bao and Manapua!  I am not familiar with any other place around Boise that has them.  And Malasadas!  So good.  So good. Satisfied my craving.  
I brought my mom here and she was pleased too.  Definitely will be back!  Also Thank you for having Hawaiian Sun drinks in stock.

Had a great lunch here while passing through Largo.  The location and flags caught my eye.  Happy I stopped to order a pork chop which came with two sides.  Quality, presentation, and price were better than expected.  While the Columbian waitress is a great young lady working hard at her job and learning English.  I absolutely will return.

Firehouse subs is certainly a local favorite for a really good sandwich. I tend to go in the fall winter and spring for a good warm sandwich that fills you up. I love that all the sandwiches have names related to a fire house and I think the atmosphere inside makes it a lot of fun for families. They have plenty of options for both adults and kids.

I get a medium smoked turkey and cheese sandwich and the Italian salad.  The Italian salad isn't just any boring salad. This salad packs a punch with flavor and dressing.

My niece and nephew get a half sandwich with the mac & cheese. They absolutely love this new option. The mac & cheese has a breading on top to give it a little bit of crunch and additional flavor and it is super tasty!

The team inside working is always really friendly and happy to greet you when you walk in. They tend to also be really great with kids.

We stopped at one of our very favorite places in Indy. Pleasant surroundings and helpful, friendly staff insure a wonderful visit.  A Gluten free chicken salad with fresh made chips and Cobb salad with house dressing. Yummy  and delicious plus a cup of tomato soup with artichoke. Hit the spot during our break from BOA grand national marching band competition. A must for anyone interested in an excellent meal.

This is a review more towards their inconsistency via Uber orders. I have given this place a few chances, but after my last order I'm done. There's ALWAYS food missing from my order, drinks missing, or wrong food items. I have gotten cheeseburgers with no meat, a toy yet no kids meal, no kids meal what so ever, and food in the wrong packaging. My last straw was what looked like a bite in the cheeseburger I ordered last night. Thankfully Uber Eats refunded all my money. If you can't handle the extra pressure from the additional business Uber Eats brings then don't do it. You're wasting my time and money.

My husband and I got carry out. This was the first pho place we tried in Indy and were so glad we checked it out. The pho was incredible. Done traditionally, the broth was full of spices. We'll definitely be back.

Such a cute place. Great food. Strong mimosas. Ken was by far the best. He made a personal list of places we should visit before leaving NOLA. Everything we ordered was amazing and tasty and flavorful. Def worth a try if you are in the area!

One of the top Korean places in my opinion!

So oddly enough... I first heard about them because of their wings!! Who would have thought? Korean place.. best wings?? But forrealz tho... BEST WINGS!!

Order online! Super easy! Was about an hour wait for 2 orders of their Dolsot Bibimbap and wings... and when I got there.. lots of people waiting. So you know it's a popular place!

Got 2 different flavors of their wings.. Honey Sesame and Soy Garlic... and flavors were on point and wings were crisped to perfection! I feel like you can see the crispness in the photos I posted! And these were good size wings! Not skimpy puny wings... like lots of meat on your wings!

The Bibimbap was so good too... you can order your amount of preferred spiciness... I ordered a 3 but didn't feel that was spicy enough, so will definitely be going higher on the spicyness. But flavors were good. Only thing I miss is the stone pot it would normally be served in if dining in the restaurant because I'm one of those that like how the rice gets crunchy from that stone pot hehe and keeps the food nice and warm. But ehhhh.. it's all takeout now so gotta deal with what we're given right? 

Will definitely be coming back.. food is awesome! Definitely try this place out if you're craving some Korean food.. or even if you're just wanting some wings... their wings are to die for!!

Had pizza and wings. I am always on the look out for great pizza so we tried this place this past weekend. The wings were good and the pizza was just ok.  It is more of a thin crust pizza and was not a very good left over pizza.  Would do the wings again but not the pizza. Sorry.

Took a bike trip north on the Monon Trail and stopped for lunch on a Sunday. They were just getting opened as we were one of the first tables. The place filled up rapidly shortly thereafter. It was GREAT to see the entire staff in face coverings, worn correctly! The outside dining area is massive. Plenty of space for appropriate social distancing and still provided a sense of unity with other diners. Service was very attentive. We had a small group and all ordered different items. I had the Melt, a smoked pork sandwich with collard greens, pimento cheese on a buttery, toasted house bread. I chose the pickles as my side which are a treat. The pork was a bit overcooked and slightly dry on some of the edges but had a great flavor balance. The cheese or maybe some aioli (the server wasn't sure) gave the sandwich a nice spicy finish. They were out of some beers and tater tots probably after a very busy Saturday night. The strangest item not available - ketchup. Near the end of our experience they turned on some music which added to the ambiance. It was awesome to dine in a safe environment with friends. Lots of bike parking and very kid-friendly. Note: there are no breakfast type items on their menu but more than enough choices. Good stuff

OMG, I am sooooo happy my boyfriend and I stumbled upon this gem. The food was amazing. It was definitely one of the best meals I've ever had in New Orleans. Jared, our server was outstanding and really made the dining experience great. Actually, everyone who worked there was so friendly and professional. The view of the city and sunset couldn't have been any more perfect. The prices were reasonable. The portions were big.  Great wine & cocktail list. I can't wait to go back for brunch and their mimosas.

We discovered this place while visiting from Southern CA. We were very impressed. The food is excellent and the staff was very friendly. We were able to sample dishes before ordering. Everything was so good it was hard to choose.

By far the best Chinese food in town.  Orders are always accurate and fast, & the flavor of the food is unmatched by any other that we've tried. 

We order and eat from there multiple times every month.

This place was SO good! The employees were very hospitable. The food came out very quickly and they were very nice to new guest! Definitely would go again! 

P.S. shout out to employee Nick for being so nice.

My daughter and I come here every once in a while, and honestly we should be coming more!! Not only is the food absolutely amazing and fresh, but our sweet server, Alyssa,  is the most attentive, pleasant and all out amazing human!!  Thank you for a most perfectly wonderful meal and service!!
The food is incredibly delicious and authentic. I love the brown stew chicken  The owner, Andre, is so nice and welcoming. Hidden gem in Tampa.

Love this place. Fresh delicious and genius combo of flavors. I have had about 10 tacos but my favorites are the Big kahuna fish tacos and the steak fajita taco. The refried beans were ok but not great. 

No photos as I gobble up my tacos as soon as I open the box. Quick and easy to go service for lunch.
You can't go wrong with an al pastor street taco or their carne asada tacos! Fast service and great tacos

Let's face it - most fast food is pretty much the same. The reason I chose Chick-fil-A today is because someone gifted me a free sandwich card. Two of them. And the fact that Chick-fil-A is a good Christian-managed company. What differentiates them from other fast-food chains is their lemonade - and their customer service. Greeted as I walked in. No fuss when I presented the card. And when I asked for a lemonade, the nice girl at the register said "I have one here that I just poured by accident. It's yours." Free. Now THAT'S customer service!

Went here last night for restaurant week. Crawfish Mac and cheese was delicious, smoked wings were a little too dark for my liking but everyone else enjoyed. 
Ricotta gnocchi and the fried chicken were amazing, hangar steak was also good but could have used more of a side (served over a few slices of potatoes). Beignets were delicious end to the meal. 
Signs inside marking way to bathrooms and tables spaced very far apart to comply with covid guidelines both inside and outside. Overall good experience

This is for their delivery/takeout that just opened. Normally we LOVE this place for their Asian fusion with great sushi and affordable prices in Center City. We usually walk here once a week before quarantine for dinner and sometimes for their viet lunch bowls. 

I was super excited to see they were doing delivery on Caviar this week, so in support of their business I placed a $150 order. Food came quicker than expected, semi warm still. But what gives this a one star rating is the fact that they knowingly served nasty old nigiri sushi and rolls. The tuna was so disgusting that I threw it away. Never in my life have I ever thrown sushi away...this was THAT BAD. I even shamefully tried to put Sriracha on it, nope, still disgusting. The tuna roll and toro scallion roll.....the tuna was slightly brown. Not the vibrant red it should be. The nigiri was terrible as well. I paid $60+ for weeks old non sushi-grade fish. Shame on you doubleknot!! The scallop was doused in wasabi to cover the fishy taste. Just absolutely disgusting. I've been to Japan twice, eaten at the famous Tsukiji market and numerous Michelin starred omakase restaurants, this was just beyond abysmal.

To top it off, the ginger and wasabi they sent was old as well. The pickled ginger was dry as paper and the wasabi was essentially dust. 

Only perk was that the warm food was still pretty good. Until they open again and have been functioning for a few weeks so that their inventory can turn over, I'm not coming here

Literally horrible!!! I came here to eat lunch for cinco de Mayo and told them I had an allergy to soy. The manager confidently said they do not use soybean oil to cook their food. Then came back AFTER I had already eaten a few chips and told me that he was wrong and that it was cooked in soy. In no circumstances is this ever acceptable. I do not recommend this establishment to anyone, ever.

One of my very favorite places in Reno. Small plates, I've tried most all and never disappointed.  The food is consistent and top notch, bar is friendly and fun.  This is my go to South Reno hang out and favorite first date spot.

The owner probably went to hell already so he is unaware that this Burger King is the worst fucking fast food restaurant in the state of Arizona. Very slow and bad service. Overall just 1.5 stars? They should have a negative rating.

My favorite breakfast place in entire Tucson. Omelettes - to die for (and definitely to come back again & again‍). Chef Cayla's choice - always delicious. One time there was a plum bread pudding - if you'll be lucky to be there on that exact day - get 2 d-e-l-i-c-I-o-u-s ! French toasts - . Also would highly recommend their teas. Great selection!

Happy to see Kb & Co is open and running full force. I decided to try the tumeric toona sandwich. At $14 it is on the pricier side but the quality is quite good. Vegetables are fresh and it comes with a side salad. 

The only tiny thing is the toona idea. While I completely understand simulation is quite difficult this sandwich had no similarities to Tuna. I think it should move away from simulation and make it there own. Either way, delicious!

Good pho, great curry and less desirable sushi.... the sushi tasted like the sushi you get from a gas station or grocery store. The roll was room temperature which caused a pretty strong fishy taste. Watch for anything listed as crab it should be spelt krab since it is the fake crab.

No "wow" factor here...a highly predictable "common food" purveyor of a lot of cheese in most everything..."25 tv's"...so who gives a crap?...noise level?...it begins with being bombarded at the party deck entrance and, although less inside, the acoustics are awfull!..my decibel meter registered 75 dB to peaks of 83 dB (alarm clock, power tools)..way over normal speech of around 55 dB.  Good service, Rueben sandwich SOS, fries SOS. My first and last visit.  Being busy, they probably don't care about getting a 5 star rating.

We went for date night and it was amazing. The service was so fast and friendly. We had the mixed dip platter as an appetizer, mixed kebab platter for me and beef for hubby and there wasn't anything that wasn't fresh, flavorful and just really good. I always get chicken but was  was glad I tried something  new because it was worth it. Although I'm sure the chicken would have been delicious as well. The platter comes with a salad, we got rice, a hummus and pita. We finished with baklava and the custard dish that neither of us could pronounce. Amazing meal, thanke

We were pleased with our visit to Bearcat during our recent trip to New Orleans. It was within walking distance from our hotel and on a beautiful early spring day, it was so nice to sit outside and enjoy breakfast.

A note before I get started: our visit was a day after Louisiana closed schools until April 13th due to the coronavirus. Restaurants were doing more to disinfect, "social distancing" was already in everyone's vernacular, and the next day, restaurants were forced to shut down or do to-go or carry out only. The outdoor area is huge and there were only about 5 tables occupied, but we were seated right next to two other groups, as if the restaurant was full. It was just kind of bizarre everyone was concerned and taking steps to stay apart, but that wasn't considered when seating us (or anyone else while we were there).

Our server Jojo was awesome- efficient, kind, and helpful during our visit. We have the bad cat breakfast and cat daddy biscuit. Both were huge portions served piping hot. The eggs with the bad cat breakfast were so salty I could not finish them, but we both loved the potatoes- crispy, but not at all greasy. The pancakes may have been the best I have ever had and the cat daddy biscuit (and the bad cat breakfast, for that matter) kept us full until dinner. The price was a little steep for what we're used to paying, but the portions, quality, service, and atmosphere made it worth it.

This is a nice little place. Got the breakfast burrito and my siblings got the breakfast burrito and open faced croissant with eggs and bacon. We got coffees hot and iced. Everything was tasty and we are looking to head back to this spot tomorrow morning.

We're visiting from out town. Las Vegas, NV, Colorado Springs, CO, Montgomery, AL
Bartender was aloof until we bonded over hockey. I wasn't prepared for east coast attitude. Draft list was varied but coming from out of town, I was hoping for more local beers.

5  Stars- because you'll never get the same service when you carry-out as when you eat-in. There are no TVs which is a pleasant break from the norm. When's the last time you were able to talk to the person eating with you without one of your eyes drifting towards what's going on on one of the many tv screens. Five stars because waffles, pecan waffles to be precise, blueberry pancakes for my wife and a nice fluffy plain waffle for my daughter. Five stars because Reuben was an excellent and very attentive server and because the food was disgustingly good.

Neat, clean, hospitable and attentive are words that go very well when dining out.

The manager came by and asked how everything was and was and of course I told him, "disgustingly good"... he offered to bring me another waffle and didn't... not cool. Just kidding. Everything was great!
I got their green eggs and ham sandwich, blueberry lemon scone and cinnamon roll. All were a 10:10 and it's the cutest shot ever! Love this place!

Don Barriga's has great Mexican food & they deliver -- it's super convenient and efficient! All the food I've had from them is good. 

Here are some more details about the food -- I use ^ to indicate a half-star and * for a full star. So, ***^ means 3.5 stars:

****^ Burrito pastor was amazing comfort food. The rice inside was tasty and perfectly textured, and I really liked the green peppers inside. Came with side of guacamole (very limey) and nachos.
****Quesadilla pastor was good. The pastor is not as flavourful as it could be, but still good & very satisfying.
***^ Gordita beef tongue: Beef tongue was quite good in texture, in a little flat sandwich.
*** Gordita tripe: Tripe was solid & had a good texture. 
*** Sope chorizo: Solid, though not my fave. The chorizo is on an open-faced tortilla with refried beans, lettuce.

DESSERT
***** Flan Napolitano: silky, smooth, delicious

SERVICE was excellent. Delivery went smoothly and was on time.

I'd happily order from Don Barriga's again and again.

A family run restaurant, Carmelita's is a friendly place to go to for good Mexican food done in a US style. Service is great and the chips, brought out almost immediately after you put out your order, are all handmade on the premises daily, having very little salt for a great toasted flavor.
The Kitchen Special is a dish of shredded chicken, salad greens, refried beans and soft, moist white rice. The meat is fresh and warm with no fat, gristle or bone hidden in it. It's very lightly seasoned so that you can season it to taste. I couldn't find any soggy lettuce or any spiny pieces, either, so that I know they take the time to make a plate they can proudly present. I wasn't able to sample the beans since my stomach doesn't handle that vegetable well.
This is a family restaurant where everyone feels welcome and you're treated well.

Love this place. Very good food. One of my favorite things is that it is vegetarian and and one of the only places that you can truly customize your dish. Thai food is my favorite but this is a great place to go!

They are open for takeout and outdoor dining 3 indoor tables for 4.  Wait outside to have your order taken, one party at a time. Wear you mask cover your nose please. (You know who you are) Great menu, lots of deliciousness healthy options. I had the chicken salad sandwich and it was great, it had small apple cabbage salad with fries. My wife Steffany had the Cobb salad, minus onions and bacon and she enjoyed it. I also had the the hair of the dog Bloody Mary, it was very tasty it came with carrots and green veggie had a orange color so I think they put a little carrot juice but I enjoyed it very much. Thanks for being open, I highly recommend this magazine street staple. Be safe cover your mouth and nose. Don't be a Maskhole.
Amazing authentic food with fresh ingredients & spices. Would definitely come back again.

A friend & I went to JJs last evening about 5:30. Not only were none of the employees (servers & hosts) wearing masks, several of them (4) were all huddled around the hostess stand & lobby area. The hostess took us to an appropriately social distanced table but tried to give us menus that had just been taken off another patron's table without being sanitized. If management is that careless about obvious precautions it makes me wonder what is going on behind the scenes.

Chicken taco 2 out of 5
Carne asada quesadilla 2.5 out of 5
Pepsi business
Salsa was 3 out of 5
$18.50 for a taco, quesadilla and a drink.  Seems pretty steep for a single $ location on Yelp.  The large quesadilla was on a medium size tortilla.  Lots of carne though.  Very average all around.  Oh and only chicken or steak, both minimally seasoned.
Food is fresh and really tasty. Prices are great. Great for take-out or a quick eat-in snack. Not the greatest location and some may be deterred, but it's worth it.
Food was great! Met the owner Poe, super cool guy. The place inside was nice and clean and workers wore masks.

Our household has been getting 2 pints every week for takeout. The Italian Butter Cookie is the most delicious ice cream I've ever had. When it's not in rotation, I get Midnight Pleasures - the second most delicious ice cream I've ever had.

Food was surprisingly very good for a chain restaurant. We had the steak and lobster fettuccine and broiled salmon. The staff was very friendly and games were quite fun. Even our 3 year old had fun playing games! Easy 3.8 out of 5 for us!
Hands down the best sushi I have ever had. Their sushi size is a perfect and everything tastes amazing.

Everything is delicious. I am not vegan or vegetarian, but all their food & drinks are absolutely delicious. I'm so excited to have Sunflower Bakehouse as a new addition to the Donelson community. It was much needed.

We came here on a late night 10pm. Ordered a pho, bo bue hei and an order of wth rolls.  It was our first time here so we didn't know what to expect with their soup. 
Wow... the pho was super tasty, lots beef, noodles were perfect.  The bo bue hei soup was also out of this world.  Egg roll very crispy.  We will definitely visit again in the future!! And we weren't super thirsty after..we drank most of the soup..

The first time I came, I only got a slice of cheesecake and it was soooo good. I was impressed enough I knew I had to come to try more things. My next time, I got a sandwich with some lemonade and it was really tasty. I finished the meal off with a slice of cheesecake and knew that this is somewhere I'd be more than happy to suggest to friends and to come back to myself.

We ate outside which was very pleasant and the food tasted good so I'm giving two stars.  However, the waiter was inattentive (for instance, had to ask for a water refill and he didn't offer us dessert options) and downright rude at times (put a large charge erroneously on my friend's card and didn't apologize).  Since they have gluten free and vegan options we had thought they would be accommodating of a different food allergy but that wasn't the case.  A water glass came out with a lipstick stain on it.  My friend used the restroom after we ate and reported it was so dirty that I should use a different one.

My first with my wife and the food was great. I had a fish dish with veggies and the wife had mixed vegetables with white rice. She enjoyed it the staff was very friendly I will be back in oh hide 2 appetizers fried wonton and also crabcoon
Breakfast was delicious and the drinks were just as good! Sat on the patio and had a great view too.

Delicious! I have lived in the area of this restaurant for almost 10 years and am surprised I have never eaten here before ... my new favorite place to go for Chinese food! Ordered beef and broccoli, cashew chicken , Kung Pao chicken and orange chicken all was delicious .. well that's what the family said. Now can't wait to try the breakfast!

In these tough times, making dinner is getting more difficult by the day. We used grub hub last night and trying to try new local spots. My husband and I prefer our crust different, mine thin and his thick, but decided to try their normal Crust and I was pleasantly happy! It was soft and puffy, but delicious. I am picky when it comes to the red sauce as I don't like it to over power the pizza. The sauce was just right and not spicy at all. My one complaint comes in the form of not enough toppings! With an all meat pizza, I want to feel like it is overflowing with all the meat! The delivery time was very quick and pizza was still warm. I would recommend this spot unless you are wanting to go cheap, definitely not cheap in price! We will return someday!

First of all this is a new restaurant so I was not expecting perfect from the door. There is some noticeable hiccups and the service being one. It was our servers first day.  The food was excellent however, 3 different  pallets , 3 different meals. All excellent. We also had dumplings that were very good. This restaurant will do well I believe after the initial hiccups. It is worth a shot ,

I came here with a few girl friends because the decor is cute and we wanted to sit on the patio to eat and have drinks. We met at the bar and my friend that made it there first ordered a frozen strawberry margarita, which is a pull of a lever... the bartender never brought her the drink and never came to say "ill be with you shortly", she continued to ignore us, so we decided to just grab a table outside. There was a few tables being used my patrons drinking cocktails, and about 15 minutes pass without anyone coming to us, so I went looking for a working employee and found one that was about to leave with cash in hand and looked at me as if I was was bothering her and I asked "how does the service work out here?" she replied "you have to let the hostess." I went inside to the empty hostess stand passing dirty tables and waiting a good 5 minutes for someone to get to the stand and let me know there was no service outside. I said okay, we will take a table for 3 inside then. I grab my friends and sit down and wait 10 minutes to be greeted with 2 servers passing us without acknowledging us, we then looked at each other and said "let's get out of here". Not sure how you plan to survive in a city that has a million different options in either direction if you can't even give SERVICE or even ACKNOWLEDGMENT to the people that walk into your establishment! Good luck is all I have to say. Will not be returning, but I will be letting all of my friends know and people that ask how my ho
Fast. Quick. GOOD Eats.  Always a pleasure to stop by.  In and Out service.  Close by when I stay in Reno.  A must to stop for Quick Eats.

I stopped here to order for pickup and saw how no one practiced social distancing. The person who answered placed me on hold for over four minutes so I hung up and went to the Dunkin' Donuts across from them. Dunkin' Donuts was super fast and got my order right. I would not recommend this place. If their customer service is this sub par Ana they don't enforce social distancing I'm not interested in them.

First time there and can't wait to return! Chorizo egg puffs are out of this world and we both had the chorizo corn skillet was super delicious. I saw the chicken and waffles served at the next table so I know what I'll have next time. Prices are very reasonable. Service was fantastic.

I'm crazy addicted to Korean fried chicken. They don't have it, but my search led to a place nearby. So while checking out the map I saw a pin for this place. Fan of Peruvian food too, hit the website and was blown away by the menu.  So on Sunday the food pilgrimage took us to City Ave with a pit stop at D'Alesandros. We had the chicken empanadas, enchiladas and half a chicken. Best enchiladas ever with great fried rice. Decent empanadas with a little tomato/onion salad heavy with the lime juice. The chicken was okay, probably was better the first day, but we were too full. Warmed the roasted potatoes a few days later and they were pretty darn good. The place leans to a fast food vibe, so I'm cautious about the ceviche, but will still try it next time. And they have gyros, chops and kabobs. A wide variety of sides and deserts.  We loved the parfaits. I could eat here 7 nights in a row and never have the same thing. BTW, the enchiladas are in flour tortillas,so don't hate me cause you don't find the "authentic ". This place is perfect for the family who can never agree on dinner and if it doesn't work for everyone, the best cheese steaks are 5 minutes away

The food and service was awesome on July 5, 2020.
Dirty, filthy, disgusting silverware. Both forks visably had someone else's food and lip and tongue prints all over them. Like they never went through the dishwasher. The knife had stuck on food on the blade.
What else was unclean and unsanitized?? A good way to pass the COVID 19...

I go here 1-2 times a year. This time we went for my birthday. Was pleasantly surprised with the awesome service we got from Jersey. She was so attentive and kind considering we came in at about 9:30 because I came from an event. They have a prefix meal during the week and it was a steal on Wednesday for 4 courses for $15! Can't beat that. 
This restaurant has been here since the 80s and hasn't changed much in appearance. The food is always decent and the dessert was awesome. We did the chocolate brownie with ice cream! yummy!

Came back for a second time within a few weeks today because I was so impressed the first time. I had to try hard not to get the same thing again because it was SO GOOD! The staff is helpful in explaining the pastries and breads and they make sure there are not too many people in the store at once. I got a custard croissant today. It was good, $4.50. It was slightly dry, but massive and the filling was definitely homemade. I'll have to go back for their AMAZING hazelnut/ Nutella roll and I'm looking forward to trying their bread and other pastries soon. Crois
nice little place open till 3 pm.  the cook brings your order. cute little lady and very friendly!!

ラーメンが食べたくて来ました。何種類かあったラーメンの中で店員さんのオススメでもやしラーメンを注文しました。麺は伸びてることも無く、スープもとても美味しかったです。もやしは思ったほど載ってませんが、牛肉、チンゲン菜、人参玉ねぎと炒めたものが載ってて満足いく量です。もやしというか野菜炒めラーメン？ゆで卵が煮卵じゃないのが少し残念ですが、スープが濃いめの味なので、これはこれでありです！また来ようと思います。

Deepwater diner is everything you'd expect. An old truck stop 24/7 diner with classic diner foods and an atmosphere to match. It attempts to cover up the stains with fresh paint, only to have the stains reappear. There's nothing glamorous or special about this place, but i love stopping here for a quick bite of classic Jersey Diner food. Its an experience everyone should make once in their lives.

My boyfriend chose Golden Triangle for our Friday date night and it did not disappoint! 

Golden Triangle offers a menu blended of Malaysian, Burmese and Thai cuisine. All the food is super aromatic and flavorful.

We ordered the Sambal Sauce chicken and Crispy Basil Beef. 

The Sambal Sauce dish was essentially a choice of meat cooked with bell peppers and onions with a strong shrimp paste -- on the fishier tasting side if you like that! A slight hint of spice too. 

The Crispy Basil was essentially the same thing but no shrimp paste, just a savory light sauce. Both dishes were satisfyingly explosive in flavor! The sauciness of the dishes paired perfectly with the rice on the side. 

We also ordered a hot Burmese tea which tasted equivalent to a hot Thai tea. It was super sweet, which was fine for someone like me with a sweet tooth. 

Prices on the menu range from $10/dish-$18/dish depending on what you order! 

Overall, the restaurant is clean, food is good and reasonably portioned, and staff is friendly! I would definitely return.

PS: They offer tea leaf salad on the menu which is something I haven't been able to find on the East coast!

I ordered 3 meals as I started to eat my meal my daughter screamed for us to eat the food.  She found a roach crawling around her chicken. When I returned the food, the manager did not seem shocked by what she saw. I will never return.

This was the last time I'll come here.  This place has terrible customer service. The food is a bit pricey for the quality received. I signed up for their Blazin rewards program at the south tampa location. I always get emails from them on specials, new menu items and whatever other solicitations they send me. Recently after our kids hockey tournament we wanted to get a beer with wings. I remembered I had received a email offering a free side with 2 wing meal purchases. When ordering our dinner, I showed the email to the server and advised her that I wanted to use it.  She didn't say that it wasn't accepted there. So we ordered our 2 snack wings with side, some beers and kids dinners. When the bill came it had the side item still charged on the receipt. I advised the server of the coupon I showed her earlier. She advised, that she put in my Reward number and it should of taken it off. But since it  didn't, there is nothing they could do.  I asked to speak to a manager since there were no stipulations on the email and I felt the server should of said they don't take the coupon when I showed it to her prior to ordering my food.  The manager just advised that the Blazin reward program I signed up for at that location in south tampa was a third party and they can't do anything about the emails sent out. What's the sense in arguing about a few dollars.  I decided to pay the bill and will take my business to Duffy's. Where they have the jumbo wings and 241 beers all day every day!

Had the fried clam strip dinner special with two sides.  It was a tasty treat along with a red Fanta Birch beer.  The wife had the breasted chicken which is always good.  The cole slaw and Mac and cheese is excellent.

My family and I were sitting outside the fountain at the Village when I smelled the delicious aroma of pizza coming from Grimaldi's. Being pregnant and driven my my nasal senses, I walked into Grimaldi's to order a pizza for takeout.

I ordered just a 12" pesto pepperoni pizza and was pleasantly surprised to find that the crust was exactly how I prefer: Thin, crispy yet chewy, and the pepperonis were mini and smoky. I assumed the pesto sauce would be under the cheese but it was actually on top. The pizza had excellent flavor and texture and I would definitely come back here.
Looooooove this place discovered it while driving running errands and im so happy i did! The ownership and staff are great too!
Walked in to a dead Cracker Barrel  and  ordered food to go. 45 min later I get my food. No one cared or did anything.  No one was here. Really bad. Will not be back. Don't even care about food.

Support local and they will remember you.  In the middle of all the craziness but before dine in service was stopped,  I  brought my friends here for breakfast. We had to wait  for  a table,  this place was packed, did I mention the  craziness already started.  The staff is wonderful,  the food is wonderful,  they treat you like family and in the midst of the crisis the community was here to support them. 
Thank you for being our favorite local spot. You fail us.

This was worth every penny. Great vibe, great staff, amazing food. It too me a year and a half to get down there, but I can't wait to go back! The Nacho's were the best I have ever had. There menu had great choices for many types of diets and restrictions.  I like that you can schedule a reservation so you don't have to wait for a table.  FYI A gift card to the Fork makes for an amazing gift.

Nudy's, I'm cranky.

I was excited because this seemed like a reliable breakfast spot, yet it still had that Ardmore-esque "somehow always smells faintly of Christmas" vibe.  I thought I was going to get a really wonderful and unique breakfast as a result.

While the price was right, the food was really not great.  Scrambled eggs with provolone seemed like a great choice but the cheese had no taste and was very rubbery.  None of the food had any seasoning.

The rye toast was good (shrug). 

My biggest issue with the food was that the potatoes are marketed as home fries, but are actually hash browns.  Those are two completely different foods.  I don't even like hash browns, but looked around at other plates nearby and didn't see anything other than hash browns.  Home fries are my favorite food on the planet - so as a potato freak I was sad to be surprised with something different. 

I got my check without an offer for a coffee refill, meanwhile every table around me got at least 1-2 offers.  I was pleasant to all of the servers but felt like because I was one person I was rushed out of there.

It was just sort of a sad experience, to be honest. =\
Decent Italian food! The inside is modern and offers a nice environment to eat. I would recommend the gnocchis with vodka sauce. The cheesesteak eggrolls were not my favorite. I would go back!

Food is decent.  Ridiculous portions, insane amount of options.  Something like 15 desserts haha!  Can't really ask what they specialize in with so many options.  But everyone who works there is very nice and helpful.  Cheap and decent cocktails.  The building is hilarious, something you'd expect at Disney.  So much to look at.  I would enjoy meeting whoever is behind the decor.  I would never choose to go eat there with my husband, but fun to bring out of town guests.
Just had a scrumptious meal on the cozy side patio tonight. Cerviche, fish tacos, chicken mole!
What a cute restaurant, the food and company was great!! The location is a little bit hard to see from the road so be careful not to drive past it.

I ate lunch here recently with a Meetup group. I had the sausage and peppers skillet ($13.00 plus tax and tip, $16.41 in all). The food and service were both good, although my eggs came over easy when I had requested scrambled.

This place is just about perfect. Really affordable, and delicious, beer ($5.00)? Check. Incredibly tasty pizza? Check. Delicious pretzels? Check. Huge place with lots of people, places to sit/ stand, and right on StateSt for people watching and other activities? Check. I can't find anything not to like!

My partner and I loved Firecracker when we went this spring! We had a Funk-A-Delic, which was great, and the One Bad Apple- seems a little out there but it TOTALLY works. Atmosphere was great and everyone was so nice and helpful. Our favorite meal of our trip to St. Louis!

I just love Ben & Irv's! First and foremost they've been wonderful during the Covid crisis to serve their customers, always with a smile on their face (metaphorically of course since we're all wearing masks). 

I love the service most especially when ordering takeout, they are always pleasant and accommodating. Obviously not able to eat in the restaurant lately but when I have in the past, the service and food have been great.

The pizza here is delicious, delicious! This is my go to pizza nearby. The service is pretty good mostly too, but the rating is for the tasty food. We usually get the 18" pizza with half pepperoni and half mushrooms. Occasionally I'll order a veggie stromboli, but be warned - get the individual if you're slender- because the normal sizes are HUGE! Great place! I'm getting hungry thinking about there food.
This business does NOT wear masks or gloves. Totally irresponsible and wrong. Please protect your patrons. I'd rather not get COVID from a taco.

I can't find too many places in the area that serve beef ribs. I was so excited to hear that the Midwestern has these as a special on the weekend. They are worth the weekly wait! So tender and full of flavor! The wings are smoky and delicious. The turkey leg is such a great bargain and will leave you totally satisfied. Haven't had a bad bite yet!

We ordered online then picked it up. Walked in and was told I didn't pay when I already did online. I left and when I got home there was literally nothing in the bag. We ordered 2 meals and 3 appetizers. They didn't give us one of the dumplings and when we called them they said they told us they were out of it but they NEVER DID. This place looked kinda sketchy, but I was super hungry - so I stopped in! 
I had 3 tacos - birria, creamy cilantro chicken, and chipotle chicken. They were surprisingly, pretty great! I'd definitely go back!
This place is amazing and they have the best fried shrimp. (: also the blueberry yum yum is the most delicious.

The fried pork dumplings were great and that's about it. We ordered Spider, Spicy Crunchy Tuna, and Shrimp Tempura rolls and everything was bland. The thing I could taste the most was the cucumber in the rolls which is not the taste most people are looking for when they order sushi.
